newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down 10 cents to 15.16 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down 10 cents to 15.16 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 10 cents to 15.16 ringgit ($6.00) a kg after a sharp overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.

"There had to be some technical correction after yesterday's rise and the market was right in following the LME," said a trader. "But the local price is still holding well as there was some support from European and local buyers."
There were offers for 170 tonnes against bids of 79, leading to a turnover of 91 tonnes against 185 tonnes on Wednesday. The local premium against London rose to $60 from $35.
